factor_policy: Each factor is an exact normal-basis Hamming-weight-3-or-4 x-coordinate represented by three increasing positions and a fourth increasing position or sentinel 83. Every mask has exactly one positional witness. Rational lifting, nonzero x, and regular affine additions are enforced by the same deterministic point circuit as the preceding pilot.
run_order: Check exact selector masks and group false lifts over GF(2^5); run one pinned-factor planted raw fiber at the same resource envelope as the direct-mask pilot; independently replay any model in checked Sage; then run public-only unpinned planted and the four frozen ordinary raw fibers, retaining all failures. Public-order sign enumeration may diagnose a bounded pinned result but does not estimate unpinned yield.
claim_boundary: Regular-locus indexed-factor PDP stage pilot only. A pinned planted solution proves correctness of that control, not unpinned search. Bounded unknown is not UNSAT. No ordinary relation, factor logs, target DLP, paired rho, or speedup may be inferred without their own verified measurements.
